title: ControlTableFile
description: A design-system package's control table as it ships (`agent-controls.json`): each interactive export's `ControlDescriptor` by export name, and under `$kinds` the control kinds the design system registers, if any. The package declares the table next to its controls, writes it at build time, and names it in its `package.json` under `oui.agentControls` (`closure.agentControls` is read during the transition; declaring both is an error). The conformance kit holds every listed component to registering with the kind declared here.

$kinds.description: The control kinds this design system registers.

ControlTable.description: A design-system package's controls, by export name: the table without its `$kinds`.

SlotDescriptor.description: One slot of a composite: its kind and the callback it binds. `callback` absent: the slot is always interactive (a toast host's toasts, whatever the page passes). `rows`: the slot registers once per row the control renders (a table's rows, a filter bar's pills), so its action takes an `item`. `defaults`: what the slot always registers, over the component's (a table's sort can be cleared), so the declared schema is as wide as the live one.

EntriesDescriptor.description: An array prop whose entries carry their own `agent` (toolbar items, menu items, selection actions).

ControlDescriptor.description: How the generator reads one design-system component where a page uses it: what kind of control it is, which of its props make it interactive, and where its schema, options, slots and nested bindings come from. The component itself registers through `useAgentBinding` with the same kind.

kind.description: What a binding on the component itself makes. Absent when it binds only per slot or per entry.

callbacks.description: Props whose presence makes a use interactive — a use with one of them must be bound. Empty: always.

schemaProps.description: Props the schema is derived from, by `SchemaProps` key: the prop of the component each comes from.

options.description: Where the options come from: the prop, and the keys of each option's value and title.

slots.description: A composite with several callbacks: slot name → its kind and the callback it binds.

rows.description: The control registers one binding per row it renders (a selectable grid), so its action takes an `item`.

container.description: A container: a dialog whose prop says whether it shows, or a tab set whose prop selects a panel.

defaults.description: What the schema props are when the page leaves them out, as the component defaults them. The declared schema is the widest the control can take; the live one may only narrow it.

display.description: It reports what it shows (`useAgentFacts`): its facts by label, under a binding the page declares, which the manifest records as one of the page's `displays`. One that only shows facts (a clip's parameters, a stat) has no `kind`, `slots` or `entries`: it is not a control, so a use without a binding is not unbound. A control or a composite that also reports what it shows (a card bound to open, a list) keeps its `kind`, `slots` or `entries` beside it. It reports under its own `agent`; a composite, under its `agent`'s `slot` binding when the page gives one, else under the first of its `parts` the page bound (as that row, when the composite has an `item`).

itemsProp.description: An array prop that holds its facts, each labelled by `labelKey`.

labelKey.description: The key of each entry of `itemsProp` that holds its label.

labels.description: Labels of facts it reports that the page does not write (a stat's `Change`), which the manifest records with the display.

slot.description: A composite's: the key of its `agent` that names what it shows apart from its controls (`facts`), as `{ id, description }`.

parts.description: A composite's: the slots whose binding it reports under, in order, when the page gives no `slot` binding.

titleProps.description: Props that give a default title, in order. `children` means the element's text.

OptionsSource.description: Where a control's options come from: the prop that holds them, and the keys of each option's value, title and, when it has one, description.

OuiPackageDeclaration.description: What a package declares to the generator under the `oui` key of its `package.json`: its control table, its room catalog, and the components only the person may use. During the transition the generator and the kit also read `closure.agentControls` and `closure.agentCatalog`; a package declaring a key under both `oui` and `closure` is an error.

agentControls.description: The path of the package's control table, relative to the package.

personOnly.description: Export name → why only the person may use it, such as the approval card. The generator refuses an `agent` binding on one, in any package, a design system's included; a person-only export is in no control table.

SchemaPropSources.description: Props a control's schema is derived from, by `SchemaProps` key (every key but `options`, which `OptionsSource` gives): the prop of the component each comes from.
